name: Amulet of Avoidance
body:
Price 2,700 gp; Aura faint transmutation; CL 3; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This amulet appears to be a large black pearl with a few flecks of gold dust across its surface. If you provoke an attack of opportunity you may activate the amulet as free action to gain a +4 dodge bonus to armor class until your next turn. This ability functions twice per day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,350 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, cat’s grace
